own_memberships_read.name: own_memberships_read
own_memberships_read.using: user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') is null

own_membership_role_read.name: own_membership_role_read
own_membership_role_read.using: nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') is null and exists (select 1 from memberships m where m.role_id = roles.id and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))

tasks_series_live_idx.name: tasks_series_live_idx
tasks_series_live_idx.where: "tasks"."repeat" is not null and "tasks"."archived_at" is null

tasks_milestone_needs_project.name: tasks_milestone_needs_project
tasks_milestone_needs_project.value: "tasks"."milestone_id" is null or "tasks"."project_id" is not null
